useCase: 检测AI生成文本ure and style 模式 through neural 特征 相关性 分析
mechanism: 提取 特征 maps from multiple layers of a pre-trained VGG-19 network. Computes Gram matrices (inner products of 特征 maps) to capture style and texture 相关性s. AI生成的 images produce characteristic Gram matrix 模式 that differ from the natural texture 相关性s found in real photographs.
accuracy: 中等 - 73-83% for style-based 检测
name: Gram 矩阵纹理分析
source: Gatys et al. (2016) - Image Style Transfer Using CNNs, CVPR; adapted for forensics
algorithm: VGG-19 Feature Extraction + Gram Matrix Comparison
parameters: Backbone: VGG-19, Layers: conv1_1 through conv5_1, Gram matrix: F^T × F normalized, Comparison: Frobenius norm distance
description: Computes Gram matrix from CNN 特征 maps to capture style and texture 相关性s. AI images produce distinctive Gram matrix 模式 different from natural photographs.

references.title: Gatys, L.A. et al. (2016). Image Style Transfer Using Convolutional Neural Networks. CVPR.
Liu, Z. et al. (2020). Global Texture Enhancement for Fake Face Detection in the Wild. CVPR.

strengths:
• Captures deep texture 相关性s
• Effective 跨 different AI architectures
• Multi-scale 分析 through multiple layers
• Well-established theoretical foundation
limitations:
• 计算成本高 (requires CNN forward pass)
• Sensitive to image 分辨率 changes
• Style transfer images may create 误报
• Requires pre-trained model weights
